title: Qofka Dahabka ah ee cidlada ku jira
intro: Bal qiyaas xero saxaro ah oo aad u ballaaran oo daqiiqad sugitaan iyo hubanti la'aan ah. Hoggaamiye weyn ayaa u baxay kulan uu la yeelanayo Ilaah, isagoo ka tagay bulsho u heellan wax la taaban karo oo ay ku dheggan tahay. Joojintaas aan nasashada lahayn, qof qancinaya ayaa hore u socda isagoo wata ballanqaadyo dhalaalaya iyo abuur caqli badan oo u muuqda mid nool.
clues: Waxaan ka mid ahaa kuwii Masar kula baxay Muuse, anigoo arkaya badda oo kala go'day si aan u baxsanno.
Waxaan daawaday markii hoggaamiyahayagu afartan habeen buurta u baxayay si uu u helo hanuun.
Waxaan dadka ka soo ururiyay qurxinta, gacmahaygana waan ku qaabeeyay.
Waxaan sameeyay weyl cod qaylo leh, dadkiina waan u yeeray.
Waxaan ka soo qaaday gacan yar oo boodh ah raadkii rasuulka oo waxaan ku tuuray wixii aan sameeyay.
Waxaa i hor yimid Muuse oo la igu xukumay inaan idhaahdo 'ha i taaban' oo aan kala noolaado, iyadoo shir la ii ballan qaaday in xukun la igu ridi doono.

identity.label: Kumaan ahay?
options: As-Samiri
Abuu Lahab
Namrud
Haamaan
Qaaruun

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Caabudidda loo dalbaday sidii sayidka ugu sarreeya Masar
Dooni ayay dhisteen si ay uga badbaadaan daadkii weynaa
Wuxuu amray dab weyn inuu gubo Ibraahim
Wuxuu sameeyay weyl dahab ah oo marin habaabiyay reer binu Israa'iil
Waxaa la qorsheeyay in la dilo Muxamed xilligii socdaalka
trial.answer: Wuxuu sameeyay weyl dahab ah oo marin habaabiyay reer binu Israa'iil

location.label: Qaybta Muhiimka ah
options: Looxyada dhagaxa ah ee Tawreed
Waxoogaa boor ah oo ka soo baxay raadkii rasuulka
Dabkii qabow ee loo diyaariyey Ibraahim
Carshigii weynaa ayaa ilbiriqsi keenay
Sanduuq alwaax ah oo laga sameeyay looxyo iyo musmaarro
location.answer: Waxoogaa boor ah oo ka soo baxay raadkii rasuulka

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Dhulku wuxuu liqay khasnado
Waxaa burburiyay qarax xooggan oo cirka ka yimid
Waxaa loo beddelay daanyeerro markii ay jabiyeen Sabtida
Waxaa badda ku qarqiyay ciidan eryanayay
Waxaa lagu xukumay inuu yiraahdo 'ha i taaban' isagoo go'doonsan oo sugaya xukun
outcome.answer: Waxaa lagu xukumay inuu yiraahdo 'ha i taaban' isagoo go'doonsan oo sugaya xukun

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
